title: [Jepsen][YСQL] Inconsistency in bank test under pause-tserver
body:
During our Jepsen on Jenkins runs, we found an issue for `yb yugabyte-2.9.1.0-b59-centos-x86_64.tar.gz bank nemesis pause-tserver`, which corresponds to YB @ 198d268f32b56c472ab9e093a714152fc66ddce9 using yugabyte/jepsen@4ea6720bff2b894761c748a1dd5230d36e971e23.
Grand total goes from 100 to 105 once, and then reverts back:
![bank](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2077017/133125865-45908f42-9983-44fa-be7d-3d0098230efb.png)

Logs (all except n2 tserver `INFO`):  
[2021-09-13_ycql_bank_pause-tserver__no-n2-tserver-info.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/7156022/2021-09-13_ycql_bank_pause-tserver__no-n2-tserver-info.zip)

n2 tserver `INFO` log (~800 MB unpacked): 
[yb-tserver.n2.root.log.INFO.20210913-051011.16123.zip](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/7156034/yb-tserver.n2.root.log.INFO.20210913-051011.16123.zip)
